name: Belarus (Byelorussian SSR, 1919–1927)
description: A red field bearing the gold letters 'ССРБ' in a rectangular frame in the upper hoist.
history: The first flag of the Socialist Soviet Republic of Byelorussia, proclaimed on 1 January 1919: a plain red banner with the republic's initials in gold, in the style of the early Russian SFSR flag. The 1927 constitution replaced it with a red flag bearing the hammer and sickle and the initials БССР.

features.role: the initials 'ССРБ' (Socialist Soviet Republic of Byelorussia) in a frame
